g.text: Terminal swing = last 15% of phase (boundary-analysis window). Tree-rigid & femur-fixed are geometric counterfactuals (not runnable); adaptive is the re-optimized N=100 max-tilt solution. MTU length from OpenSim 4.4 exact geometry, phase-normalized.
